title: EyesUp keyboard layout
description: One physical keyboard layout: which finger presses each key, what each key types, and the order keys are taught. See docs/layout-format.md. Rules that span several fields (one home key per finger, every learnable key exactly once in learnOrder) are checked by scripts/validate-layouts.mjs.

id.description: Layout id, also the file name without .json, e.g. qwerty-us.

language.description: BCP-47 language of the practice content.

fingerprint.description: Physical key codes and the character each produces on this layout. Used to detect the layout from live keystrokes.

learnOrder.description: Groups of key codes, introduced one group at a time. The first group must contain KeyF and KeyJ.

deadKeys.description: For each dead-key accent, the character produced by each following key. A space after the accent produces the accent itself.

code.description: A KeyboardEvent.code value from the UI Events specification, e.g. KeyF, Semicolon, IntlBackslash.

character.description: The character the key types, a control name (Shift, CapsLock), or Dead:<accent> for a dead key.

width.description: Width in key units (1u = one letter key).

rowSpan.description: Set on the ISO Enter key, which spans two rows.

finger.description: L/R hand; 1 index, 2 middle, 3 ring, 4 little; T thumb.

bump.description: Key has a tactile bump (F and J positions).

learn.description: false for keys never drilled (Tab, Caps Lock, Backspace).
